description: Obscures a summary so that no human names are present. Using a given `summary` text content I remove all human name references and replace them with the first letter of their name(s), capitalized.
name: obscure

itemId.description: The id of the item to be obscured, provided in prompt variables

obscuredSummary.description: The cleaned and obscured text content, original content provided in prompt variables
obscuredSummary.example: "John Doe is at Google" becomes: "J is at Google"
